observations.description: A wide shot shows a corner kick being taken by the white team. The ball is crossed into the penalty area where players from both teams jump to head it. The ball is cleared away from the goal. The camera then cuts to a close-up of the goalkeeper in a dark blue kit holding the ball and looking towards the field.

The scene cuts to a wide shot of an attack near the goal. A player in white receives a pass inside the penalty box and shoots the ball towards the goal. The goalkeeper in a bright yellow kit dives to his left and makes a save, pushing the ball away. The camera follows the ball as it goes out of play, and the goalkeeper gets up.
